title: Coordinating Threads: sleep, join, and isAlive

blocks.value: sleep(ms) pauses the current thread for the given number of milliseconds. join() makes the calling thread (often main) wait for another thread to finish before continuing; passing a millisecond limit to join(ms) caps how long it will wait.
By the time both isAlive() calls run, the earlier join() calls have already waited for each thread to completely finish, so both correctly report false.
